roadmap.title: Example Power & Light: Data & AI Roadmap

pillars.name: Keep the lights on
pillars.description: Fewer and shorter outages across the network.

pillars.name: Affordable bills
pillars.description: Lower cost to serve, passed through in rates.

pillars.name: Cleaner generation
pillars.description: Connect and run more renewables, faster.

data_categories.name: Assets & work
data_categories.description: What the network is and what crews did to it

use_cases.name: Predictive Vegetation Management
use_cases.summary: Trim where the next outage will be, not where the cycle says.
use_cases.business_problem: Tree contact causes a large share of distribution outages, and trimming is scheduled on fixed cycles regardless of growth or risk.

value.basis: Avoided outage restoration cost and deferred trim spend
value.formula: circuit miles x trim cost per mile x share re-prioritised + avoided restoration

plan.headline: Rank circuits by tree risk before the next trim season.
plan.pilot: Two operating regions with their outage history and trim records

phases.name: Crawl
phases.title: Score tree risk on two regions
steps: Join outage cause codes to the network model
Compare against this year's trim plan

phases.name: Walk
phases.title: Re-sequence the trim plan
steps: Feed the ranked list to the trim contractor

use_cases.name: Storm impact prediction and crew pre-staging
use_cases.summary: Forecast damage by area 72 hours out and stage crews before the storm.

value.basis: Fewer mutual-assistance crew-days and faster restoration

use_cases.name: Outage Detection & Prediction
use_cases.summary: Spot outages from meter last-gasp signals before customers call.

use_cases.name: Wildfire ignition risk scoring
use_cases.summary: Score every span's ignition risk daily from asset condition, fuel and weather.
use_cases.business_problem: Power-shutoff decisions rely on regional weather alone, which switches off far more customers than the risk requires.

data_requirements.rationale: Ignition risk needs asset age and condition joined to fuel and weather.

value.basis: Avoided shutoff customer-minutes and liability exposure

use_cases.name: Solar fleet underperformance recovery
use_cases.summary: Find and price the solar faults that cost the most energy, and fix those first.

use_cases.name: Interconnection queue triage
use_cases.summary: Predict which interconnection requests will reach operation, and study those first.
use_cases.kpi: Months from application to interconnection agreement

use_cases.name: Billing anomaly and theft detection
use_cases.summary: Catch estimated, mis-rated and tampered bills before they go out.

use_cases.name: Field crew assistant
use_cases.summary: A conversational assistant that answers procedure and asset-history questions on the job.
